mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% within 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction signal Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns during early recession regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0 and regime is early recession, or Rank IC < 0.03 in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals late-cycle economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 in late-cycle slowdown regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces near-term corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 new jobs per month signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 100000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
